reference: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
hypothesis: Some hotels have heritage from the steam railway and large passenger ships of the past; before World War II, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

source: Hizi ni hoteli ambazo watu tajiri na maarufu enzi zile wangeishi, na mara nyingi walikula na kujitumbuiza.
reference: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
hypothesis: These are the hotels where the wealthy and famous used to stay, and often dine and entertain themselves.

source: Zana hizo za kale, ukosefu wa huduma za kisasa, na uzee fulani wenye neema pia ni sehemu ya tabia zao.
reference: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
hypothesis: Those old tools, lack of modern services, and certain benevolent ageism are also part of their nature.

source: Japo huwa zinamilikiwa kibinafsi, wakati mwingine huwa zinatumiwa kuwapokea marais wanaozuru, pamoja na waheshimiwa wengine.
reference: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
hypothesis: Although they are usually privately owned, they are sometimes used to receive visiting presidents, as well as other dignitaries.

source: Msafiri aliye na vitita vya pesa huenda akafikiria safari ya ndege kuzunguka ulimwengu, inayositishwasitishwa kwa kukaa katika nyingi ya hoteli hizi.
reference: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
hypothesis: Travelers with a lot of money may consider taking a plane ride around the world, stopping at many of these hotels.

source: Kubadilishana mitandao ya ukarimu ndio shirika linalounganisha wasafiri na wenyeji kwenye miji wanayoizuru.
reference: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
hypothesis: Exchanging hospitality networks is the organization that connects travelers and locals in the cities they visit.

source: Kujiunga na mtandao kama huo kwa kawaida kunahitaji tu kujaza fomu ya mtandaoni; hata hivyo mitandao mingine itatoa ama kuhitaji uhakiki zaidi.
reference: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
hypothesis: Joining a network like this usually requires just filling out an online form; however, other networks may offer or require more verification.

source: Orodha ya wenyeji wanaopatikana hutolewa kwa kuchapishwa kwenye nakala na/au mitandaoni, wakati mwingine pamoja na marejeleo na hakiki kutoka kwa wasafiri wengine.
reference: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
hypothesis: An inventory of locals is provided by publications and/or online, sometimes including references and reviews from other travelers.

source: Kulala kwenye nyumba za watu kwa muda kulianzishwa mnamo Januari 2004 baada ya mtengenezaji wa programu za kompyuta Casey Fenton kupata safari ya ndege ya bei nafuu kuelekea Aislandi lakini hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa.
reference: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
hypothesis: Sleeping in people's homes for free was started in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but had nowhere to stay.

source: Akawatumia wanafunzi wa chuo kikuu chaa ndani barua pepe na akapata matoleo mengi sana ya malazi ya bure.
reference: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
hypothesis: He sent emails to university students offering free accommodation.

source: Hosteli hushughulikia vijana kimsingi - mgeni wa kawaida ana miaka ishirini hivi - lakini mara nyingi unaweza kuwapata wasafiri wazee huko pia.
reference: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
hypothesis: Hostels cater to young people mainly - the average guest is around twenty years old - but you can often find older travelers there too.

source: Familia zilizo na watoto si jambo la kawaida, lakini baadhi ya hosteli huwaruhusu katika vyumba vya kibinafsi.
reference: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
hypothesis: Having children in a family is not common, but some hostels allow them in private rooms.

source: Mji wa Beijing nchini Uchina utakuwa mji mwenyeji wa mashindano ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi mwaka wa 2022, ambayo itaifanya Beijing kuwa mji wa kwanza kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki ya majira ya joto na baridi.
reference: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
hypothesis: Beijing, China will be the host city of the 2022 Winter Olympic Games, making it the first city to host both the Summer and Winter Olympic Games.

source: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za kufungua na kufunga na matukio ya ndani kwenye barafu.
reference: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
hypothesis: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and indoor events at the Winter Olympics.

source: Matukio mengine ya kuteleza kwenye theluji yatakuwa katika eneo la Taizicheng katika Zhangjiakou, takribani kilomita 220 (maili 140) kutoka Beijing.
reference: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
hypothesis: Other snowfall events will take place in the Taizicheng area of Zhangjiakou, approximately 220 kilometers (140 miles) from Beijing.

source: Hekalu nyingi zina sikukuu ya Kila mwaka kuanzia mwishoni mwa Novemba hadi katikati mwa Mei, ambayo hufautiana kulingana na kalenda ya mwaka ya kila hekalu.
reference: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
hypothesis: Many temples have an annual festival from the end of November to the middle of May, which varies according to the calendar of each temple.

source: Sherehe nyingi za Hekaluni zinaadhimishwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa kwa mungu anayeongoza au tukio lolote jingine kuu linalohusiana na hekalu.
reference: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
hypothesis: Many celebrations of Hekaluni are held as part of temple festivities, the birthday of the temple's deity, or any other major event related to the temple.

source: Tamasha za hekalu za Kerala ni za kufurahisha sana kuona, kwa msafara wa mara kwa mara wa ndovu waliopambwa, bendi za hekalu na tamasha nyinginezo.
reference: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
hypothesis: Kerala temple festivals are a sight to behold, with the regular procession of decorated elephants, temple bands and other festivities.

source: Maonyesho ya Dunia (kwa kawaida yanajulikana kama World Exposition, au Expo tu) ni tamasha kubwa ya kimataifa ya sanaa na sayansi.
reference: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
hypothesis: World Expositions (also known as World's Fairs or Expos) are large-scale international exhibitions of art and science.

source: Nchi zinazoshiriki huwasilisha maonyesho ya kisanaa na kielimu katika kumbi za kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya kidunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.
reference: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
hypothesis: Participating countries present cultural and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase their global issues, culture, and history.

source: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Maua ni matukio maalum ambayo huonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za mimea na kitu chochote kingine kinachohusisha mimea.
reference: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
hypothesis: International Flower Shows are special events that showcase flower displays, plant gardens, and anything else related to plants.

source: Ingawa katika nadharia zinaweza kutokea kila mwaka (mradi zako katika nchi tofauti), kwa mazoezi hazipo.
reference: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
hypothesis: Although in theory they can occur every year (depending on the country), in practice they are rare.

source: Matukio hayo huwa kwa miezi mitatu hadi miezi sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo yasiyopungua hekta 50.
reference: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
hypothesis: These events usually take place over a period of three to six months and are held on sites of at least 50 hectares.

source: Kuna aina nyingi za filamu ambazo zimetumika kwa miaka. Filamu ya milimita 35 (kanda hasi ya milimita 36 kwa milimita 24) ni ya kawaida zaidi.
reference: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
hypothesis: There are many types of film that have been used for years. The 35mm film (36mm wide by 24mm high) is the most common.

source: Kwa kawaida inaweza kujazwa tena kwa urahisi kiasi ikiisha, na hutoa ubora wa mwonekano unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule wa DSLR ya sasa.
reference: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
hypothesis: It can be refilled easily once it is empty, and provides an image quality comparable to that of current DSLRs.

source: Kamera ingine za muundo wa kati zinatumia muundo wa 6 kwa 6, kwa usahihi 56 kwa 56 hasi.
reference: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
hypothesis: Another mid-range cameras use a 6x6 format, precisely 56x56 pixels.

source: Hii hutoa ubora wa mwonekano karibu mara nne ya ule wa picha hasi ya milimita 35 (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).
reference: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
hypothesis: This provides an image quality of almost four times that of a 35mm negative (3136 mm2 compared to 864).

source: Wanyama pori ni miongoni mwa michoro yenye changamoto zaidi kwa mpiga picha, na inahitaji mchanganyiko wa bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vizuri.
reference: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
hypothesis: Wildlife photography is one of the most challenging genres, requiring a combination of luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

source: Upigaji picha za wanyamapori mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa urahisi, lakini kama upigaji picha kwa ujumla, picha ina thamani ya maneno elfu.
reference: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
hypothesis: Taking pictures of wildlife is often taken for granted, but as a general rule, a picture is worth a thousand words.

source: Mara nyingi upigaji picha za wanyamapori huhitaji lenzi ndefu, ingawa vitu kama kundi la ndege au kiumbe mdogo huhitaji lenzi nyingine.
reference: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
hypothesis: Often, photographing wildlife requires a long lens, although things like a flock of birds or a small creature may require a different lens.

source: Ni vigumu kupata wanyama wengi wa kigeni, na mbuga wakati mwingine huwa na sheria zinazohusu upigaji picha kwa ajili za kibiashara.
reference: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
hypothesis: It is difficult to find many foreign animals, and sometimes parks have regulations regarding commercial photography.

source: Wanyamapori wanaweza kuwa wenye aibu au wakali. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au makali kwa vinginevyo.
reference: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
hypothesis: Wild animals can be shy or aggressive. The environment can be cold, hot, or otherwise harsh.

source: Ulimwengu una zaidi ya lugha 5,000, zikiwemo zaidi ya ishirini zilizo na wazungumzaji zaidi ya milioni 50.
reference: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
hypothesis: There are more than 5,000 languages spoken in the world, with more than 20 of them having more than 50 million speakers.

source: Maneno yaliyoandikwa mara nyingi huwa rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyotamkwa, pia. Hii huwa hususan ni kweli kwa anwani, ambazo aghalabu huwa vigumu kutamkwa kwa busara.
reference: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
hypothesis: Words written down are often easier to understand than words spoken, especially when it comes to addresses, which are usually difficult to articulate accurately.

source: Mataifa mengi mazima huzungumza Kiingereza kwa ufasaha kabisa, na kwa hata mengine mengi unaweza kutarajia ufahamu mdogo - hasa miongoni mwa watu wenye umri mdogo.
reference: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
hypothesis: Many countries speak English fluently, and for many more, you can expect a basic understanding - especially among younger generations.

source: Fikiria, ukitaka, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, na Msydney wakiwa wameketi wamezunguka meza wakila chajio mkahawani katika Toronto.
reference: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
hypothesis: Think of, if you want, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, and Msydney sitting around a table eating a delicious meal in Toronto.

source: Wanaburudishana na hadithi kutoka kwa mitaa ya manyumbani kwao, inayosemwa katika lafudhi zao tofauti na lugha ya kienyeji isiyo rasmi.
reference: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
hypothesis: They are exchanging stories from their hometowns, spoken in their own dialects and informal language.

source: Kwa kawaida, kununua chakula katika supamaketi ndiyo njia ya bei rahisi kabisa ya kujilisha. Bila fursa za kupika, machaguo hata hivyo yamepunguzwa kwa chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari.
reference: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
hypothesis: Generally, buying food at a supermarket is the most affordable way to feed oneself. Without cooking options, however, the choices have been limited to pre-made food.

source: Maduka makubwa yanazidi kupata seehemu ya chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari. Baadhi ya maduka makuu hutoa tanuri ya miale ya kupasha chakula joto.
reference: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
hypothesis: Large supermarkets are increasingly offering pre-made meals. Some of the larger stores even offer ovens for hot food.

source: Katika baadhi ya nchi au aina za maduka kuna angalau mkahawa kwenye eneo, mara nyingi usio wa kirasmi na wenye bei nafuu.
reference: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
hypothesis: In some countries or types of stores, there is at least a cafe on the premises, often informal and inexpensive.

source: Tengeneza na ubebe nakala za hati ya bima na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya mtoa huduma wako wa bima.
reference: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
hypothesis: Create and carry copies of your insurance policy and contact details of your insurance provider.

source: Wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe na nambari za simu za kimataifa za mtoa bima kwa ushauri/idhini na kufanya madai.
reference: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
hypothesis: They need to provide the email address and international mobile phone numbers of the insurer for advice/authorization and to make claims.

source: Kuwa na nakala nyingine katika mzigo wako na mtandaoni (baruapepe iliyo na kiambatisho kwako mwenyewe, au kuhifahiwa kwenye “wingu”).
reference: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
hypothesis: Have a copy of your luggage both online (a barcoded attachment to your own message, or stored in the “cloud”).

source: Kama unafasiri na kipakatilishi au kibao, hifadhi nakala kwenye kadi kasima yake(unayoweza kufikia bila mtandao)
reference: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
hypothesis: If you translate with a dictionary or a tablet, save a copy on a flash card (that you can access offline).

source: Pia toa nakala za sera/mkataba kwa wenzi wa kusafiri na jamaa au marafiki nyumbani walio tayari kusaidia.
reference: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
hypothesis: Also provide copies of the policy/contract to the traveling companions and family or friends at home who are willing to help.

source: Kongoni (pia wanajulikana kama elk) hawana fujo kiasili, lakini watajitetea ikiwa watakisia kuna hatari.
reference: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
hypothesis: Elks (also known as elk) are not naturally aggressive, but they will defend themselves if they feel threatened.

source: Wakati watu hawaoni kongoni kama anayeweza kuwa hatari, huenda wakamsogea karibu sana na kujiweka hatarini.
reference: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
hypothesis: When people do not see the danger in this person, they may get too close and put themselves at risk.

source: Kunywa vinywaji vyenye pombe kwa kiasi tu. Pombe inaathiri kila mtu kwa njia tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.
reference: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
hypothesis: Drink alcoholic beverages in moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limits is essential.

source: Matukio ya kiafya ya muda mrefu kutokana na kunywa kupita kiasi yanaweza kujumuisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Kuwepo kwa hatari huongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa kiharamu.
reference: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
hypothesis: Long-term health effects from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The risk increases when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

source: Mivinyo isiyo halali inaweza kuwa na uchafu mwingi hatari pamoja na methanoli, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.
reference: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
hypothesis: Illicit alcohol can contain many dangerous contaminants, including methanol, which can cause blindness or even death even in small amounts.

source: Miwani inaweza kuwa bei rahisi katika nchi ya kigeni, haswa katika nchi za mapato ya chini ambapo gharama za kazi ziko chini.
reference: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
hypothesis: Glasses can be cheaper in foreign countries, especially in low-income countries where labor costs are low.

source: Fikiria kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, haswa ikiwa bima inaugharamia, na kuleta agizo nawe ili lifailiwe mahali pengine.
reference: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
hypothesis: Consider having your eyes examined at home, especially if the insurance covers it, and bring the prescription with you to have it filled elsewhere.

source: Fremu za kifahari za kampuni tajika ambazo hupatikana katika maeneo kama haya zina shida mbili; baadhi huenda zikawa ni nakala zisizo na leseni, na zile halisi zilizoletwa ndani huenda zikawa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.
reference: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
hypothesis: High-end furniture from prestigious companies found in places like these have two issues; some may be counterfeit, and the authentic ones imported may be more expensive than those made locally.

source: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa sana duniani, na labda unaweza kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.
reference: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
hypothesis: Coffee is one of the most widely traded commodities in the world, and you may find many varieties in your local area.

source: Walakini, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa ulimwenguni kote ambazo zinafaa kushuhudiwa.
reference: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
hypothesis: However, there are many unique ways to drink coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

source: Kuingia kwenye korongo (au: canyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya korongo, ambayo imekauka au imejawa na maji.
reference: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
hypothesis: Canoeing is about going down a canyon, which may be dry or filled with water.

source: Mchezo wa korongo huchanganya vipengele kutoka kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini unahitaji mafunzo kiasi au hali nzuri ya kimwili ili kuanza (ukilinganishwa na kupanda mwamba, upigaji mbizi wa scuba au kuteleza milimani, kwa mfano).
reference: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
hypothesis: Canoeing combines elements of swimming, climbing and flying--but requires some training or good physical condition to start (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or mountain sledding, for example).

source: Matembezi ni shughuli ya nje ambayo huwa na kutembea katika mazingira asili, mara nyingi katika njia za matembezi.
reference: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
hypothesis: Walking is an outdoor activity that involves walking in natural environments, often along trails.

source: Matembezi ya mchana huhusisha umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali zaidi ambao unaweza kufikiwa kwa siku moja.
reference: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
hypothesis: Day hikes involve distances ranging from a few miles to much longer distances that can be completed in one day.

source: Kwa matembezi ya mchana kando ya njia rahisi maandalizi kidogo yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote aliye na usawa wastani wa kimwili anaweza kufurahia.
reference: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
hypothesis: For a leisurely afternoon stroll along the path, a bit of preparation is necessary, and anyone with an average physical fitness level can enjoy it.

source: Huenda familia zilizo na watoto wadogo zikahitaji matayarisho mengi, lakini siku moja nje inawezekana kwa urahisi hata kukiwa na watoto wachanga na wale walio karibu kwenda shuleni.
reference: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
hypothesis: It is likely that families with young children will require more preparation, but one day out can be easily managed even with infants and those close to school age.

source: Kimataifa, kuna mashirika karibu 200 ya ziara za mbio. Nyingi kati yazo hufanya kazi kwa uhuru.
reference: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
hypothesis: Globally, there are almost 200 race tourism organizations. Many of them operate independently.

source: Mrithi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours huunganisha makundi mengi ya kutoa huduma ya ukimbiaji na utazamaji kwenye mabara manne.
reference: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
hypothesis: Go Running Tours, the successor to Global Running Tours, brings together a variety of groups to provide running and sightseeing services on four continents.

source: Kwa mizizi ya Running Tours huko Barcelona na Copenhagen’s Running kwa Copenhagen, ilijumuishwa haraka na Running Tours huko Prague na wengineo.
reference: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
hypothesis: With the roots of Running Tours in Barcelona and Copenhagen’s Running for Copenhagen, it was quickly followed by Running Tours in Prague and others.

source: Kuna mambo mengi sana unayofaa kutilia maanani kabla na wakati wa kusafiri mahali.
reference: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
hypothesis: There are many things you should consider before and during your travel.

source: Unaposafiri, tarajia mambo yasiwe kama yalivyo “nyumbani”. Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, mahali pa kulala, viwango, lugha na kadhalika zitatofautiana kwa kiwango fulani na mahali unapoishi.
reference: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
hypothesis: When travelling, expect things to be different from what you are used to “at home”. Habits, laws, food, traffic, sleeping arrangements, standards, language and so on will vary to some degree from where you are.

source: Hili ni jambo ambalo unahitaji kukumbuka kila wakati, ili kuepuka kukata tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za kawaida za kufanya mambo.
reference: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
hypothesis: This is something you need to remember all the time, in order to avoid getting discouraged or even frustrated with the usual ways of doing things.

source: Mawakala wa usafiri wamekuwapo tangu karne ya 19. Kwa kawaida wakala wa usafiri huwa chaguo zuri kwa safari ambayo ni zaidi ya uzoefu wa awali wa msafiri wa maumbile, utamaduni, lugha au nchi za mapato madogo.

hypothesis: If you have extra time to travel, check out how your total ticket cost to Africa compares to the cost of traveling around the world.

source: Usisahau kuongeza gharama za ziada za visa za ziada, ushuru wa kuondoka, usafiri kwenye ardhi, n.k., kwa sehemu hizo zote nje ya Afrika.
reference: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
hypothesis: Don't forget to add extra visa fees, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc., to those destinations outside of Africa.

source: Ikiwa unataka kusafiri kuzunguka ulimwengu katika Kizio cha Kusini, machaguo ya ndege na mahali si mengi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa ndege zinazosafiri kuvuka bahari.

hypothesis: If you want to travel around the world in the Southern Hemisphere, your options for flights and destinations are limited due to the lack of airlines that fly across the ocean.

source: Hakuna muungano wa ndege unaohudumia vivukio vyote vitatu vya bahari katika Ulimwengu wa Kusini (na hakuna kivukio ambacho SkyTeam inahudumia).
reference: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
hypothesis: No airline alliance serves all three major South African airports (and none of them are served by SkyTeam).

source: Hata hivyo, Star Alliance hushughulikia kila kitu isipokuwa South Pacific ya mashariki kutoka Santiago de Chile kwenda Tahiti, ambayo ni safari ya LATAM Oneworld.

hypothesis: However, Star Alliance handles everything except the East South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

source: Safari hii ya ndege siyo chaguo la pekee kama unataka kuruka Pasifiki Kusini na pwani ya magharibi ya Marekani Kusini. (tazama chini)
reference: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)
hypothesis: This flight is not the only option if you want to fly over the South Pacific and the Southern US coast. (see below)

source: Mnamo 1994, eneo la Azabaijan lililo la Nagorno-Karabakh kikabila lilifanya vita dhidi ya Azeris.
reference: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
hypothesis: In 1994, the ethnic Armenian region of Nagorno-Karabakh declared war on the Azeris.

source: Kwa kuungwa mkono na Armenia, jamhuri mpya iliundwa. Hata hivyo, hakuna nchi thabiti - si hata Armenia - huitambua kirasmi.
reference: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
hypothesis: With the backing of Armenia, a new republic was formed. However, no country - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

source: Hoja za kidiplomasia dhidi ya eneo hilo zinaendelea kutatiza uhusiano kati ya Armenia na Azerbaian.
reference: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
hypothesis: Armenia and Azerbaijan's diplomatic tensions have been further aggravated by the ongoing diplomatic efforts.

source: Wilaya ya Canal (Kiholanzi: Grachtengordel) ni wilaya maarufu ya karne ya 17 inayozunguka Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
reference: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
hypothesis: Canal Ring (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is a popular 17th century district surrounding Amsterdam's inner city.

source: Wilaya nzima imeteuliwa kama Pahali pa Urithi wa Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Elimu, Sayansi na Utamaduni kwa thamani yake ya kipekee ya kitamaduni na kihistoria, na thamani yake ya mali ni kati ya zile za juu zaidi ya nchi.

hypothesis: Entire region has been designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its economic value is among the highest in the country.

source: Cinque Terre, yaani Ardhi Tano, ina vijiji vitano vya kipwani vya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso vilivyo katika eneo la Kiitaliano la Liguria.
reference: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
hypothesis: Five Lands, or Cinque Terre, consists of five coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian Riviera region of Liguria.

source: Wameorodheshwa katika Orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia ya UNESCO.
reference: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
hypothesis: They have been listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

source: Kwa karne nyingi, watu walijenga matuta kwa umakini katika mandhari yenye mawemawe na mwinuko hadi kwenye majabali yaliyo juu ya bahari.
reference: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
hypothesis: For centuries, people have built towers with great care in a landscape of craggy rocks and steep cliffs, reaching up to the highest peaks of the sea.

source: Sehemu ya haiba yake ni ukosefu wa maendeleo ya shirika yanayoonekana. Njia, treni na maboti huunganisha vijiji, na magari hayawezi kuvifikia kutoka nje.
reference: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
hypothesis: Part of its charm is its lack of visible infrastructure. Roads, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot access them from outside.

source: Aina za Kifaransa zinazozungumzwa katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinatofautiana kidogo na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, ingawa zinalingana kiasi cha kueleweka baina yazo.
reference: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.
hypothesis: French dialects spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from French spoken in France, although they are mutually intelligible.

source: Hasa, mfumo wa hesabu katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinazozungumza Kifaransa una mambo yasiyo ya kawaida ambayo ni tofauti na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, na matamshi ya maneno kadhaa ni tofauti kidogo.
reference: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.
hypothesis: Especially, the accounting system in Belgium and Switzerland speaking French has peculiarities that differ from French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

source: Walakini, Wabelgiji wote waliozungumza Kifaransa na Kiswisi walijifunza Kifaransa shuleni, kwa hivyo wangeweza kukuelewa hata ukitumia mfumo wa nambari wa Kifaransa.
reference: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.
hypothesis: However, all the Belgians who spoke French and German had learned French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the French numerical system.

source: Katika sehemu nyingi za dunia, kupunga mkono ni ishara ya kirafiki, kuashiria "hujambo."
reference: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."
hypothesis: In many parts of the world, giving a high-five is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello".

source: Walakini, huko Malaysia, angalau kati ya Malay katika maeneo ya vijijini, inamaanisha "kuja huku," sawa na kidole cha kwanza kilichoelekezwa kuelekea kwenye mwili, ishara ambayo hutumiwa katika nchi fulani za Magharibi, na inapaswa kutumiwa tu kwa sababu hiyo.
reference: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.
hypothesis: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come here," similar to the first finger pointed towards the body, a gesture used in some Western countries, and should only be used for that purpose.

source: Vivyo hivyo, msafiri wa Uingereza huko Uhispania anaweza kukosea kuagana kwaheri kwa kupepa kuhusisha viguzo akikabilia mpepapi (badala ya mtu anayepepewa) kama ishara ya kurudi.
reference: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
hypothesis: Similarly, a British traveler in Spain may misunderstand the farewell gesture of waving goodbye with a clenched fist (instead of a person being given) as a sign of returning.

source: Lugha saidizi ni lugha bandia au za kubuniwa zinazoundwa kwa lengo la kusaidia mawasiliano kati ya watu ambao vinginevyo wangepata shida ya kuwasiliana.
reference: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.
hypothesis: Assisted languages are artificial or designed languages created to facilitate communication between people who would otherwise have difficulty understanding each other.

source: Wao ni tofauti na lingua Francas, ambayo ni lugha asilia au ya kikaboni ambazo huwa maarufu kwa sababu moja au nyingine kama njia ya mawasiliano kati ya wasemaji wa lugha nyingine.
reference: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.
hypothesis: They are different from the Romance languages, which are native or natural languages that are popular for one or more reasons as a means of communication between speakers of other languages.

source: Katika joto la siku, wasafiri wanaweza kuona mazigazi ambayo hutoa dhana ya maji (au vitu vingine).
reference: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).
hypothesis: In the heat of the day, travelers can see steam rising from the ground, giving the impression of water (or other substances).

source: Hizi zinaweza kuwa hatari ikiwa msafiri atafuata mazigazi, kupoteza nishati ya thamani na maji iliyobaki.
reference: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.
hypothesis: These can be dangerous if the traveler follows the trails, loses valuable energy and water.

source: Hata jangwa lililo na joto zaidi linaweza likawa baridi sana usiku. Hipothemia ni hatari halisi bila mavazi ya joto.
reference: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.
hypothesis: Even the hottest desert can be very cold at night. Hypothermia is a real danger without warm clothing.

source: Katika kiangazi, hasa, utahitaji kujihadhari na mbu ukiamua kutembea katika msitu wa mvua.
reference: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.
hypothesis: In the summer, especially, you should be careful of mosquitoes when walking in the rainforest.

source: Hata ikiwa unaendesha kupitia msitu wa mvua wa kitropiki ndogo, sekunde chache milango ikiwa wazi unapoingia kwenye gari ni muda unaotosha kwa mbu kuingia na wewe garini.
reference: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.
hypothesis: Even if you are driving through a small tropical rainforest, the few seconds the doors are open when you enter the car is enough time for mosquitoes to enter with you.

source: Homa ya ndege inaweza kuambukiza ndege na pia mamalia.
reference: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
hypothesis: Bird flu can be transmitted to both birds and mammals.

source: Kesi chache chini ya elfu zimewahi kuripotiwa kwa wanadamu, lakini baadhi yazo zilipelekea kifo.
reference: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
hypothesis: Only a few cases below a thousand have been reported to humans, but some of them have resulted in death.

source: Mengi yamehusisha watu ambao hufanya kazi na kuku, lakini pia kuna hatari kiasi kwa watazama ndege.
reference: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
hypothesis: Many people are involved in working with chickens, but there is also a certain risk associated with watching birds.

source: Kawaida kwa Norwei kuwa na vilango-bahari vyenye miinuko mikali na mabonde ambayo ghafla hugeuka kuwa kilima kirefu tambarare ambacho ni bapa, kwa kadiri fulani.
reference: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.
hypothesis: It is customary for Norway to have steep sea cliffs and deep fjords that suddenly turn into flat, wide plains.

source: Nyanda hizi za juu mara nyingi huitwa "vidde" kumaanisha nafasi pana, wazi isiyo na miti, eneo lisilo na mipaka.
reference: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.
hypothesis: These high plains are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open, treeless area with no boundaries.

source: Katika Rogaland na Agder kwa kawaida huitwa "hei" kumaanisha ardhi iliyotengwa isiyo na miti na mara nyingi hufunikwa na mimea ya vichakani.
reference: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.
hypothesis: In Rogaland and Agder, the term "hei" is used to refer to a cleared area of land without trees, which is often covered in heather.

source: Mabarafuto si imara, lakini yanatiririka kuenda chini ya mlima. Hii itasababisha nyufa, mianya, ambayo inaweza kufichwa na madaraja ya theluji.
reference: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.
hypothesis: Snow is not solid, but it slides down the mountain. This can cause crevices, cracks, which can be hidden by snow bridges.

source: Kuta na paa za mapango ya barafu zinaweza kuporomoka na nyufa zinaweza kuzibwa.
reference: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.
hypothesis: Ice caves and glaciers can collapse and crevices can be blocked.

source: Kwenye ukingo wa barafuto vipande vikubwa hujitenga, kuanguka na pengine kuruka au kubingirika mbali zaidi na ukingo.
reference: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.
hypothesis: On the edge of the ice sheet, large chunks break away, falling and potentially bouncing or sliding further away from the edge.

source: Msimu wa watalii kwa vituo vya vilimani kwa jumla hupata shughuli nyingi wakati wa kiangazi cha Kihindi.
reference: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.
hypothesis: Tourist season for the hill stations in general experiences a lot of activity during the Indian summer.

source: Hata hivyo, vina urembo na haiba ya aina fulani wakati wa msimu wa baridi, na vituo vingi vya vilima hupata viwango vya kutosha vya theluji na kutoa shughuli kama utelezaji na utelezaji kwa vibao.
reference: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.
hypothesis: However, they have a certain charm and character during the winter season, and many mountain resorts receive adequate snowfall and offer activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

source: Ni mashirika machache tu ya ndege ambayo bado hutoa nauli ya kufiwa, ambayo hupunguza kidogo gharama ya kusafiri kwa mazishi dakika ya mwisho.
reference: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.
hypothesis: There are only a few airlines that still offer discounted fares for last minute travel, which can reduce the cost of attending a funeral.

source: Ndege zinazotoa hizi ni pamoja na Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kwa ndege zinazotoka Marekani au Kanada, na WestJet.

source: Katika visa vyote, lazima ujitengee nafasi mapema kwa kupiga simu moja kwa moja kwenye shirika la ndege.
